profilingPlan: Retrieve only the pinned publisher archive and verify the published MD5 plus a locally computed SHA-256 without committing the raw archive.
Enumerate experiment IDs and all internal files from the delivered archive rather than inferring counts from descriptions.
Profile upper and lower injection streams independently and preserve delivered time bases, units and cycle grouping.
Separate pressure actual from pressure target and separate measured velocity/volume from commands, targets, states or derived fields using source semantics.
Exclude both screw-driving JSON streams from injection-moulding sample totals while preserving their experiment-link metadata for cross-process educational analysis.
Count accepted measured injection time-series values only from delivered direct-measurement arrays or columns with ordering/time basis established.
Emit aggregate schemas, counts and fingerprints only; never upload raw third-party rows or arrays as workflow artifacts.
evidenceBoundary: The Zenodo record describes a real cross-process manufacturing dataset with two injection-moulding streams sampled at approximately 1 kHz and two downstream screw-driving streams sampled at 833.33 Hz. The official Zenodo records API confirms CC BY 4.0, so automated retrieval and aggregate profiling are permitted. Downstream screw-driving samples cannot enter injection-moulding totals, and target/reference fields cannot be counted as measurements. The pinned 685.5 MB archive remains queued for hosted profiling; no cycle or measured-value total is accepted until its published MD5 and internal contents are validated.
